c001.zh: 多指手势开始时立即切到缩放/移动优先，避免测量吸附和单指平移状态干扰缩放焦点。
c001.en: Switch to zoom/move priority immediately when a multi-finger gesture starts, to avoid measurement adsorption and single-finger panning states from interfering with the zoom focus.

c002.zh: 缩放由 ScaleGestureDetector 独占处理；同步当前位置，防止缩放结束后下一次单指移动使用旧坐标导致跳动。
c002.en: Scaling is handled exclusively by ScaleGestureDetector; the current position is synchronized to prevent the next single-finger movement after scaling ends from using old coordinates and causing jitter.

c003.zh: 记录剩余手指的位置，避免从双指缩放回到单指时出现位移突变。
c003.en: Record the position of the remaining fingers to avoid sudden changes in displacement when zooming from two fingers back to one finger.

c004.zh: 确保 GEN 操作送入画布仿真引擎
c004.en: Make sure GEN operations are fed into the canvas emulation engine

c005.zh: 确保预演数据与当前文档同步
c005.en: Make sure preview data is in sync with the current document

c010.zh: 合并所有板材的排版结果
c010.en: Merge layout results for all panels

c011.zh: 平移该板材的所有实体
c011.en: Translate all entities of this sheet

c022.zh: 检查是否超出板材边界
c022.en: Check if plate boundary is exceeded

c025.en: Check for parts that cannot be placed

c028.zh: 无法放置任何零件，可能是零件太大
c028.en: Unable to place any part, maybe the part is too big

c029.zh: 按名称扣减数量，避免同名零件被整组误删
c029.en: Deduct quantity by name to avoid accidentally deleting parts with the same name from the entire group

c033.zh: 尝试找到最接近的板材尺寸
c033.en: Try to find the closest plate size

c034.zh: 移除当前位置之后的历史

c035.en: Sort by area from largest to smallest

c036.zh: 对每个零件类型进行排列

c038.zh: 从左到右、从上到下扫描
c038.en: Scan from left to right, top to bottom

c041.zh: 计算浪费面积（简化：使用右下角空间）
c041.en: Calculate wasted area (simplified: use bottom right space)

c042.en: Try placing at the current line

c043.zh: 如果当前行放不下，尝试新行
c043.en: If the current row does not fit, try a new row
